style_suffix: Children's picture-book illustration, soft gouache and coloured-pencil texture, rounded friendly shapes, warm golden-hour light, palette of golden straw #E2C27A, sun-baked terracotta #C4623D, deep forest green #2F5D46, weathered wood #8A6A4F, dragon-fruit pink #E0457B, mango #F4A62A, leafy green #6BAA3F, cream paper #F6EBD3; no text, no letters, no watermark.

page-3-poem.prompt: Colouring book page, pure black line art on a plain white background ... a large Vietnamese conical palm-leaf hat (nón bài thơ) seen from the front ... a woman in a long flowing áo dài dress, a small rowing boat on two gentle waves, and a lotus flower with two round leaves ...

page-4-market.prompt: Colouring book page, pure black line art on a plain white background ... a cheerful Vietnamese street market where everyone wears a conical nón lá hat: three smiling fruit sellers ... a bamboo shoulder pole with two baskets, a bicycle, two simple stalls with striped awnings, and a neat stack of conical hats for sale ...
